match_rationale_en: The national target quantifies adoption of diversified, sustainable, and resilient agricultural production systems.
The sector target increases financing for credit lines that promote resilient agricultural production systems.
The action expands credit for agricultural-system resilience within an integrated landscape approach.
The action expands aquaculture practices that are resilient to climate variability.

The target expands climate-adaptation rural-development programmes that support productive inclusion and income generation, but does not focus on fisheries-dependent households or alternative sectors.
Ethnodevelopment projects support food security and income generation for traditional families, providing an indirect livelihood-diversification pathway.
The target strengthens income generation and economic autonomy among traditional and family-producer organizations, but does not explicitly address climate-affected fishing livelihoods.
The health-sector objective explicitly prepares resilient infrastructure and teams to maintain care under climate impacts.
The action supports a hospital-sector climate plan covering infrastructure adaptation, patient safety, and resilient health units.
The target requires SUS resilience against extreme climate events in all territories identified as most vulnerable.
The target covers infrastructure, teams, procedures, and continuity of health services during extreme climate events in every region.
The target provides 200,000 efficient water-capture and storage technologies for climate-resilient production.
The action implements efficient water collection and storage systems for food production.
The action implements individual and collective systems to capture, store, and distribute water for consumption.
The action supports microbasin water-conservation structures through finance, implementation, partnerships, and training.
The target quantifies localized-irrigation and water-reuse projects for family farming.
The action implements localized irrigation and water reuse in family-farming production systems.
The action provides technical assistance on water-efficient sustainable aquaculture in climate-sensitive locations.
The target increases industrial water reuse and reduces abstraction through 2035.
The action promotes industrial and mining water recycling and reuse systems.
The water-resources objective explicitly links water security to watershed revitalization and reliable water quality and quantity.
The action identifies priority basins for recovery and sources used for public supply for protection under climate scenarios.
The action implements and monitors wetland, protected-area, soil, source-water, and aquifer-recharge restoration projects.
The action establishes national participatory governance for river-basin revitalization.
The action implements quantified basin-revitalization projects to improve infiltration, flood resilience, erosion control, and water quality.
